Radio here denotes the longer-than0.1m bin in this specific strip. Photon energy follows frequency, not drawn height or amplitude. No claim of biological risk, safe exposure, all colours or an observed emission spectrum. Native1300 is a faint mostly text-bearing strip; its exact category wording/units are not decoded or copied. This independent log-coordinate model is not an exact-source table. Large-format/continued-sheet output must preserve40mm per decade; do not squeeze to a small sheet or silently enlarge visible alone while retaining a quantitative common-axis claim. Actual medium-specific export/page checks remain pending. Teacher/audio introduces the log-coordinate rule, approximate named regions and continuation beyond both selected ends. No visible numerals, formula glyphs, letters or Braille are added. Region IDs and numerical endpoints are invisible metadata. Continuous boundaries mark conventional classifications, not physical walls between kinds of radiation. External learned identity/quantity/axis/phase/projection key required. Actual printing,largeformat page/devicefit,touch,tracing,calibration and recognition pending.", "geometry_exception": "Native1.2mmgraphiclinedots/global3.1mmguard,notBraille/standaloneplanetmarkers.
